title: Genesis 18:13-14 beside the angel's words to Mary (headed Matthew 1:34-37)
summary: Pairs the promise of Sarah's son (Genesis 18:13-14) with the angel's announcement to Mary (labelled Matthew 1:34-37, though the quoted words are those of Luke 1:34-35): the Holy Spirit will come upon Mary and the holy Child shall be called the Son of God. Matching colours (I, you, her, Son) link the two passages.

text.text: 13 And the LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh,
saying, ‘Shall I indeed bear a child, when I am so old?’
14 “Is anything too difficult for the LORD?
At the appointed time I will return to you,
at this time next year, and Sarah will have a son.”
“How can this be, since I am a virgin?”
35 The angel answered and said to her,
“The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the
Most High will overshadow you; and for that reason the
holy Child shall be called the Son of God.
